display.purpose: Project name and one launch promise.

evidence.purpose: URLs, dates, events, and verification state.

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: Groups one chain of search, source, and date evidence.
components.css: .ds-evidence-panel { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; color: #F2F7F5; background: #10201C; border: 1px solid #274038; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-panel strong { color: #22D3C5; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Verified Label
components.css: .ds-verified-label { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 10px; color: #07110F; background: #22D3C5; border-radius: 0; font: 600 14px/1.4 Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

narrative.overview: A chain-of-custody visual system for the live web. Direct language and structured proof stay distinct, connected by one verified signal.
keyCharacteristics: One teal signal moving through dark neutral space
Strong sans display type with compact mono evidence labels
Flat geometry, explicit connections, no decorative glow
Dates, URLs, and verification states treated as first-class content

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Verified Teal is the only saturated color.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Never add an outer neon glow, purple haze, or mesh gradient.

rules.name: The Human First Rule
rules.body: Lead with plain-language consequence; use mono only for actual machine evidence.

dos: Do make search, open-page, URL, event date, and uncertainty states visible.
Do label the project as an unofficial community project.
donts: Don't use generic AI-tool marketing with purple gradients or glowing brains.
Don't build fake terminal dashboards that imply runtime proof.
Don't use OpenAI visual mimicry or suggest an official plugin.
